notes: The source URL (biology-for-transfer-as-t.xml) and the text belong to Skyline's Biology for Transfer A.S.-T, not Environmental Science A.S.-T. The outcomes refer to biology ('Apply principles of math, chemistry and physics to the study of biology.'; 'Apply knowledge of biological organisms and principles in advanced courses in order to transfer to four year institutions.'). The structure is also the Biology TMC: Core Courses (10 units) are BIOL 215 and BIOL 230; List A (23 units) is CHEM 210 and CHEM 220, MATH C2210 or MATH 241, and PHYS 210/220 or PHYS 250/260. For these reasons no blocks, outcomes or totals were recorded for Environmental Science.
No Environmental Science section heading appears in the text, so section_heading is left empty.
Closed-list courses specific to Environmental Science (ENVS 100, GEOG 100/101, GEOL 210, ECON C2001, STAT C1000) do not appear anywhere in the text.
The text begins mid-way through an outcomes list (items 6-7) and is cut off during the PHYS 260 row.
A reviewer should fetch the correct Environmental Science A.S.-T catalog page.
